te: The Philippines moves its national calendar to align with other Asian countries' calendars by skipping Tuesday, Decembe…
dz: 菲律宾通过跳过1844年12月31日星期二来移动其国家日历来与其他亚洲国家的日历保持一致. 纳西索·克拉夫里亚总督下令改革国家日历,使其与亚洲其他地区保持一致。 自1521年3月16日斐迪南·麦哲伦抵达菲律宾后,其地盘已落后于亚洲其他地区一日323年.
de: The Philippines moves its national calendar to align with other Asian countries' calendars by skipping Tuesday, December 31, 1844. The change has been ordered by Governor–General Narciso Claveria to reform the country's calendar so that it aligns with the rest of Asia. Its territory has been one day behind the rest of Asia for 323 years since the arrival of Ferdinand Magellan in the Philippines on March 16, 1521.
